title: NCAA Regionals Weekend
blurb: Every D-I and D-III regional, where the nationals fields are decided, plus this week's high school championships, with live results and streams in one place.
seo: NCAA Cross Country Regionals Live Results & Streams
desc: Live results and streams for every 2026 NCAA Division I cross country regional (Nov. 13) and Division III regional (Nov. 14), plus the New Jersey Meet of Champions, Maryland and Arizona state finals and the New England championships.

meets.name: NCAA D-I Mountain Regional Cross Country Championships
meets.where: Albuquerque, NM
meets.why: The toughest region in the country. Men: No. 1 New Mexico, No. 2 Colorado, No. 6 BYU and No. 20 Northern Arizona. Women: No. 1 BYU, No. 6 Northern Arizona, No. 7 New Mexico, No. 9 Colorado and No. 16 Utah. The top two teams and the top four individuals not on those teams qualify automatically for the NCAA Championships on Nov. 21.
